options: The doorway was not wide.
The doorway was unusually wide.
The doorway was far above the roof.
clue: Focus on width.
explanation: The doorway was not wide.

context: A damaged cable interrupted the building's power supply.
prompt: Which interpretation best fits this context?
options: It interrupted the delivery of office furniture.
It interrupted the provision of electricity.
It interrupted the flow of drinking water.
clue: Consider what the cable carries.
explanation: It interrupted the provision of electricity.

context: The reusable spacecraft was described as a technical achievement.
prompt: Which interpretation best fits this context?
options: It was only a change in ticket prices.
It was a natural event with no engineering involved.
It was a successful technological accomplishment.
clue: Focus on successful technology or engineering.
explanation: It was a successful technological accomplishment.

context: The bakery hopes to make a profit this year.
prompt: Which interpretation best fits this context?
options: It hopes to earn more than it spends.
It hopes its costs will exceed its income.
It hopes to give away every product without income.
clue: Compare income with expenditure.
explanation: It hopes to earn more than it spends.

context: A new safety procedure is now in place.
prompt: Which interpretation best fits this context?
options: The procedure is merely an unapproved suggestion.
The procedure is established and functioning.
The procedure has been permanently abandoned.
clue: Consider whether the arrangement is actually operating.
explanation: The procedure is established and functioning.

context: The talk ended, and the workshop began soon afterwards.
prompt: Which interpretation best fits this context?
options: The workshop began long before the talk.
The workshop began at an unspecified date years later.
The workshop began a short time after the talk.
clue: Look at the order and the short interval.
explanation: The workshop began a short time after the talk.
